d: Long, chestnut-brown hair is styled in a high ponytail with long, straight bangs framing the face. The eyes are a bright sky-blue with a calm, focused expression, set on a youthful face with a mature demeanor. The build is slender and athletic, dressed in a tan-and-brown military ensemble consisting of a camouflage-patterned long-sleeved shirt under a heavy brown tactical plate carrier vest, paired with olive-drab cargo pants and brown boots. Signature accessories include fingerless tactical gloves, multiple utility pouches around the waist and thighs, a sidearm in a thigh holster, and a large, olive-green recoilless rifle resting on the shoulder.
